title: Going deeper: Conflict without recruiting a crowd
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Transfer respectful communication into groups, classrooms, friendships and help-seeking.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The conflict still needs support and boundaries.
practice: speak to the people involved or seek a trusted helper
principle: Reduce audience pressure and choose a safer conflict pathway.
nextSentence: The conflict still needs support and boundaries. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can speak to the people involved or seek a trusted helper.
keyLearning: Reduce audience pressure and choose a safer conflict pathway.
